bio: I'm a creative visionary with one goal in mind spread across countless outlets: represent my true self and make art doing it.  From coding games/websites/apps, to building my car, I have always felt the desire to create what reflects my personality. When I'm not behind a screen, you can find me either behind the movie screen or the camera myself, documenting my life to look back on.
